messages:
oliver_support: FYI customer reporting invoice much higher than their SDK estimator. Thread with repro attached — @carla_eng can you triage?

bob_cust: We got charged 12,540 tokens for a single generate call; our local SDK estimator returned ~3,912. Repro below. Hoping for a quick triage, this hit billing.

bob_cust: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-2.1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the quarterly metrics in 3 bullets."}],"functions":[{"name":"lookup_db","parameters":{"query":"company_metrics"}}],"stream":false}'
```

bob_cust: Node SDK estimate we called before sending (estimator v0.9.2):

```js
const est = await client.tokens.estimate({ messages, functions });
// est.tokenCount -> 3912
```

oliver_support: Quick clarifying Qs: did you supply any system messages? were you streaming? does the tool return anything large (attachments, long provenance)?

bob_cust: No explicit system messages. Not streaming. The function `lookup_db` returns a JSON object that includes a long `trace` field (audit text + provenance ~8k chars) and we do attach that to the conversation on the server side to show context for the analyst.

carla_eng: Thanks — two immediate hypotheses: 1) server-side prefill/audit entries are being injected as hidden assistant messages for the request (counted by metering but not by the client estimator), or 2) the tool output (we persist/format provenance) is appended to the assistant response after your SDK estimates.

carla_eng: Can you re-run with the debug header to get a token breakdown? Add `X-Redwood-Debug: true` (this returns a non-prod-only `token_breakdown` field in the response).

bob_cust: Ran that now, here's the relevant snippet from the API response (redacted):

```json
{"token_breakdown": {"total": 12540, "by_role": {"user": 3912, "assistant": 628, "server_preamble": 7720}}}
```

bob_cust: So `server_preamble` is ~7720 tokens. That matches the long `trace` being added.

carla_eng: Confirmed. Root cause: we are attaching tool provenance/audit text server-side as a hidden assistant/system message for observability and post-hoc debugging. Metering counts model input/output tokens after all injections; the client-side estimator only tokenizes the messages you send. Result: mismatch.

carla_eng: Short-term mitigations:
- You can set header `X-Redwood-Disable-Server-Preamble: true` on the request to opt out of the server-injected audit prefill (we'll add this as an account-level flag if you need it persistently).
- Add query `?include_token_breakdown=true` or header `X-Redwood-Debug: true` to see the breakdown before you pay.

carla_eng: Long-term: engineering will: 1) patch the SDK estimator to surface server_preamble token counts when the debug flag is on; 2) make server prefill opt-out by default for accounts in the next release. ETA: SDK patch + toggles in ~48 hrs.

oliver_support: Thanks. Next steps for support: offer one-time credit for the unexpected tokens while eng ships fix. @billing_bot can you create a ticket to review invoice 2026-03-14-789 and hold charges pending confirm? :pray:

billing_bot: billing_bot: Ticket created: BILL-4721. Hold placed on invoice 2026-03-14-789 for review. Notified finance.

carla_eng: Repro steps for customers/devs to verify locally:

```bash
# debug breakdown
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' -H 'X-Redwood-Debug: true' -X POST \
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?include_token_breakdown=true' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2.1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize..."}],"functions":[{"name":"lookup_db","parameters":{"query":"company_metrics"}}]}'

# quick opt-out of server prefill
curl -H 'X-Redwood-Disable-Server-Preamble: true' -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '<payload>'
```

carla_eng: Action items: eng will push SDK patch that surfaces server_preamble in estimator (PR opens in 2 hours), support to offer credit and verify with the customer after they test opt-out, billing will keep invoice on hold until patch/confirm.

bob_cust: Tried the `Disable-Server-Preamble` header — tokens dropped to ~3,920 in the token_breakdown. Thanks, that reproduces the reduction. Please proceed with SDK patch and credit.

oliver_support: Great. I'll follow up on credit confirmation and close the loop once engineering sends the PR. :thumbsup:

carla_eng: FYI for eng-infra: the capture/attach behavior was added last quarter to improve observability; we'll add a toggle and ensure metering docs mention server-injected content.

billing_bot: Billing note: provisional credit queued pending confirmation from support.

oliver_support: Closing loop — if anyone else hits this, recommend `X-Redwood-Disable-Server-Preamble: true` and `X-Redwood-Debug: true` while we finish the SDK update.
